_note: Poly Medicure (Polymed) fact base, consolidated unless stated, ₹ crore. Only documents published on or before 30-Sep-2026. AR FY26 = annual report 2025-26 dispatched with the 31st AGM notice on 14-Aug-2026 (NSE filing POLYMED_14082026203838; full PDF later placed on the company website).

ar26.what: Annual report FY26 (notes 26/29 other income, 38 acquisitions, 52 QIP, related parties, remuneration)

ar25.what: Annual report FY25 (other income note 25, QIP note 50)

profile.summary: India's second-largest medical-device maker and its largest exporter of medical consumables: 225+ devices in 15 specialties, 15 plants in 5 countries, sales in 125+ countries through 1,000+ distributors, 590+ direct sales staff, 390+ patents (399 at Jun-2026), ~1.9 bn units a year of capacity. Third-largest IV cannula maker in the world (~11% global share, ~600 mn pieces, Q4FY26 call); first Indian maker of dialysis products.
profile.plants: India: Faridabad (104-105, 115-117, IMT 1 and 2), Jaipur SEZ 1 and 2, Haridwar 1 and 2; abroad: Amaro and Bologna (Italy), Leek (Netherlands), Laiyang (China), Assiut (Egypt, associate). Two new plants: Palwal/Faridabad (orthopaedics, transfusion, extra infusion capacity; online by Mar-2027) and Noida/YEIDA medical park (cardiology; commercial Q1FY28).
profile.utilisation: 65-70% of the capacity built after the 2021 QIP (Q4FY26 call)
profile.rdTeam: 90+ in India, Italy and the Netherlands; R&D 1.7% of sales, to double in 3-5 years

segments.notes: FY23-26 segment split restated in the Q4FY26 PPT (FY25 infusion 1,012 vs 1,050 in the old split). 'Others' = critical care/vascular access (PICC, CVC, ports), transfusion, cardiology, orthopaedics, surgery, urology, gastro, anaesthesia and export incentives. Stents are only ~₹10-12 cr of revenue (Q4FY26 call). Infusion ~50% of revenue in Q4FY26 and Q1FY27 (57% in Q4FY25; ~68% in FY20).

otherIncomeNote.screenerExceptional: Screener labels FY25 ₹44 cr and FY26 ₹46 cr of other income 'exceptional': these are the mutual-fund gains (FY25 ₹6.27 + 37.73 cr = ₹44.0 cr), i.e. treasury income on the QIP cash, not one-offs. The company reports no exceptional items in FY21-25.

FY26.note: Labour-code provision (past-service gratuity and leave, 21-Nov-2025 notification) shown as an extraordinary expense; transaction costs of the PendraCare and Citieffe deals (₹3.2 cr Q2, ₹6.5 cr Q3) excluded from operating EBITDA by the company. After-tax at the 25.17% statutory rate (deductibility of transaction costs not disclosed).

shares.qip2021: ₹400 cr QIP in FY21 (Sep-2020), before our valuation window

plan1health.what: Plan1Health, Amaro (Italy): long-term implantables, oncology ports, pain-control pumps; Class III devices
plan1health.note: Revenue 3.2x and margin +970bp since purchase; the 'P1H playbook' management wants to repeat

pendracare.what: PendraCare group, Leek (Netherlands): guiding and diagnostic catheters for interventional cardiology, OEM supplier to two large OEMs, FDA-approved guiding catheter
pendracare.middleEastShare: ~20% of sales; not growing in FY27 (Q1FY27 call)

citieffe.what: Medistream SA (Switzerland) holding Citieffe SRL (Bologna, Italy) and subsidiaries in the US and Mexico: trauma and extremity implants (internal and external fixators, nails with navigation software); #2 in Italy and Mexico
citieffe.growth: flat in CY25 (a LatAm tender cancelled); 10-12% in EUR guided for FY27; mid-to-high single digit so far

medyneo.what: Medyneo (Brazil): dormant distributor holding ANVISA and import licences

himalayan.what: Himalayan Mineral Water Pvt Ltd: bought through an IBC resolution plan (NCLT Allahabad 12-Aug-2025, NCLAT 19-Mar-2026); ₹33.16 cr paid; control not yet transferred at Mar-26; purpose not explained in the filings we read

acquisitions.steadyStateMarginPct: 12-14% now, 18-20% in 2-3 years with synergies (Q4FY26 call)
acquisitions.integration: Moving parts of production to India needs regulatory approval (in progress); cross-selling into India needs CDSCO import registration (6-9 months); benefits expected from FY28 (Q1FY27 call)

fy27: Consolidated revenue ₹2,300-2,400 cr incl. a full year of PendraCare and Citieffe (May-2026; kept in Aug-2026)
Standalone revenue ₹1,900-2,000 cr (₹1,900-1,950 cr in May): domestic >20%, international >15%
Standalone EBITDA margin 25-27% (upper end expected); consolidated 23-25%
Standalone gross margin 68-69% (Q1 71.5% helped by price increases and inventory gains); consolidated 71-72%
Renal growth 15-20% (anti-dumping probe on Chinese/Malaysian dialysers; 20% injury margin claimed)
guidance.vision2030: Revenue 2x by FY30 (~18% a year), ~80% organic / ~20% acquired; 'industry-leading' margins but similar to today in the near term; R&D spend doubled; 25-30 launches a year; direct sales in 3-4 more European countries, Brazil and the US

capex.crisilView: ₹200-300 cr a year, mainly from internal accruals
capex.projects: Haridwar plant 2 (2026), gamma-sterilisation plant (operational FY26), Palwal/Faridabad (Mar-2027), Noida/YEIDA medical park (Q1FY28)

regulatory.src: q4ppt p.38-39; q1ppt p.11; ar26 directors' report
regulatory.us: Polymed 4 FDA approvals with 3-4 in the pipeline; Citieffe 10 approved, 8-10 in the pipeline; PendraCare guiding catheter approved; Plan1Health 1 (OEM). Group: 15 approvals, 11-13 more pending (Q1FY27). US exports only USD 3.5-4 mn in FY27; tariff 10%; GPO contracts signed
regulatory.europe: All manufacturing sites certified to EU MDR 2017/745 (AR FY26); Polymed 82 CE approvals, 15 pending; ~25 products awaiting CE marking within 3-4 months (Aug-2026)
regulatory.india: Stents are under NPPA price caps (coronary stents capped since 2017); most Polymed consumables are not price-controlled; Chinese dialysers enter duty-free via ASEAN (anti-dumping probe initiated on Polymed's application); inverted duty on raw materials
regulatory.recall: ANSM (France) safety notice on the Neoflow flow regulator for infusion lines, 30-Oct-2025
